sourceFile: 36. BRS-201506 Report checking and test C-PT happen bending date 12.4.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable bending/function evidence but the comparison grouping and extracted measurement outcomes are not reliable enough for Ask AI.
issues: Normal baseline is only evidenced for function, not clearly for process vision bending results.
Bending little/much and PT bending little/much may be separate test stages, not one clean changed condition set.
Sheet1 AWF settings are setup context, not validated outcome results.
Measurement outcomes appear auto-extracted from headers/text and are not meaningful metrics.
Some key cited result rows are not shown in context, limiting verification of values.
requiredUserQuestions: Is Normal intended as the baseline for all tests or only the function summary?
Should Sheet1 AWF conditions be treated only as test setup context?
correctionPlan: Regroup changed factor around C-PT bending severity/test stage with clear baseline scope.
Keep process vision and function outcomes under the same report only with stage-specific conditions.
Remove Sheet1 and bogus text/header measurements from outcomes unless supported by real data rows.
Cite the actual condition/result rows for rows 15,16,36,38,40 and preserve table grouping.
Recompute defect rates and add judgement only after grouping is corrected.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but current citations are insufficiently grouped and include non-outcome rows.
